request.project_task: Create a marketplace buyer-seller dispute workflow.
request.project_goal: Resolve order disputes with traceable evidence and deadlines.
request.project_description: A buyer opens a dispute, both parties provide evidence, and a mediator decides or proposes a settlement.

functional_requirements.text: A buyer opens a dispute for an eligible order.

atoms.text: A buyer opens a dispute for an eligible order.

functional_requirements.text: The buyer selects a reason and requested outcome.

atoms.text: The buyer selects a reason and requested outcome.

functional_requirements.text: The buyer and seller upload evidence before a deadline.

atoms.text: The buyer and seller upload evidence before a deadline.

functional_requirements.text: The system notifies each party about new evidence.

atoms.text: The system notifies each party about new evidence.

functional_requirements.text: A mediator reviews order history and evidence.

atoms.text: A mediator reviews order history and evidence.

functional_requirements.text: A mediator proposes a settlement or records a decision.

atoms.text: A mediator proposes a settlement or records a decision.

functional_requirements.text: Either party accepts a proposed settlement.

atoms.text: Either party accepts a proposed settlement.

functional_requirements.text: The system closes the dispute after decision or mutual settlement.

atoms.text: The system closes the dispute after decision or mutual settlement.

non_functional_requirements.text: Evidence must be immutable after the submission deadline.
A mediator must not access disputes with a declared conflict of interest.

actors.name: Buyer
actors.description: A marketplace buyer who can open and participate in disputes.

actors.name: Seller
actors.description: A marketplace seller who can participate in disputes.

actors.name: Mediator
actors.description: A neutral mediator who reviews disputes and proposes settlements or records decisions.

use_cases.name: Open Dispute
use_cases.goal: Buyer opens a dispute for an eligible order by selecting a reason and requested outcome.
use_cases.trigger: Buyer decides to dispute an eligible order.

preconditions.text: Buyer is authenticated and has an eligible order.

success_postconditions.text: Dispute is created with reason and requested outcome, and evidence deadline is set.

failure_postconditions.text: Dispute is not created; buyer is informed of the reason.

steps.action: Buyer selects an eligible order to dispute.
Buyer selects a dispute reason and requested outcome.
steps.expected_result: System records reason and requested outcome.

steps.action: System creates the dispute and sets an evidence submission deadline.
steps.expected_result: Dispute is created and deadline is set.

steps.action: System detects the order is not eligible for dispute.
steps.expected_result: System informs buyer that the order is not eligible.

user_stories.capability: open a dispute for an eligible order
user_stories.benefit: I can seek resolution for a problematic order

system_stories.system_action: Validate order eligibility and create dispute with reason, requested outcome, and evidence deadline.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure only eligible orders can be disputed and capture required dispute details.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Open Dispute
Goal: Buyer opens a dispute for an eligible order by selecting a reason and requested outcome.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Buyer decides to dispute an eligible order.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Buyer is authenticated and has an eligible order.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Buyer selects an eligible order to dispute.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Buyer selects a dispute reason and requested outcome.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System creates the dispute and sets an evidence submission deadline.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Order not eligible
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002

use_cases.name: Submit Evidence
use_cases.goal: Buyer and seller upload evidence before the deadline, and the system notifies each party about new evidence.
use_cases.trigger: Dispute is open and evidence deadline has not passed.

preconditions.text: A dispute exists and is open.
The evidence submission deadline has not passed.

success_postconditions.text: Evidence is uploaded and stored immutably; both parties are notified.

failure_postconditions.text: Evidence is not accepted; uploader is informed.

steps.action: Buyer uploads evidence for the dispute.
steps.expected_result: System validates the upload is before the deadline.

steps.action: System stores the evidence immutably.
steps.expected_result: Evidence is stored and cannot be altered.

steps.action: System notifies the seller about new evidence.
Seller uploads evidence for the dispute.
steps.expected_result: System validates the upload is before the deadline.

steps.action: System stores the evidence immutably.
steps.expected_result: Evidence is stored and cannot be altered.

steps.action: System notifies the buyer about new evidence.
System detects the evidence deadline has passed.
steps.expected_result: System rejects the upload and informs the uploader.

user_stories.benefit: I can support my dispute with evidence
I can defend my position with evidence

system_stories.system_action: Validate upload timing, store evidence immutably, and notify the other party.
system_stories.responsibility: Enforce evidence deadline and immutability, and keep parties informed.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Submit Evidence
Goal: Buyer and seller upload evidence before the deadline, and the system notifies each party about new evidence.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Dispute is open and evidence deadline has not passed.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: A dispute exists and is open.
  - PRE-UC002-002: The evidence submission deadline has not passed.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Buyer uploads evidence for the dispute.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] System stores the evidence immutably.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] System notifies the seller about new evidence.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-ALT-001: Seller uploads evidence
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Evidence deadline passed
Source FRs: FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.name: Mediator Reviews Dispute
use_cases.goal: Mediator reviews order history and evidence for a dispute.
use_cases.trigger: Mediator is assigned to a dispute and opens it for review.

preconditions.text: A dispute exists and is open.
Mediator is assigned to the dispute and has no declared conflict of interest.

success_postconditions.text: Mediator has reviewed order history and evidence.

failure_postconditions.text: Mediator cannot access the dispute due to conflict of interest.

steps.action: Mediator opens the assigned dispute.
steps.expected_result: System verifies mediator has no conflict of interest.

steps.action: Mediator reviews order history.
Mediator reviews submitted evidence.
System detects mediator has a declared conflict of interest.
steps.expected_result: System denies access to the dispute.

user_stories.capability: review order history and evidence for a dispute
user_stories.benefit: I can make an informed decision

system_stories.system_action: Verify mediator has no conflict of interest and present order history and evidence.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure mediator access is conflict-free and provide necessary information.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Mediator Reviews Dispute
Goal: Mediator reviews order history and evidence for a dispute.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: Mediator is assigned to a dispute and opens it for review.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: A dispute exists and is open.
  - PRE-UC003-002: Mediator is assigned to the dispute and has no declared conflict of interest.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Mediator opens the assigned dispute.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Mediator reviews order history.
  3. [STEP-UC003-003] Mediator reviews submitted evidence.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Conflict of interest
Source FRs: FR-005

use_cases.name: Mediator Proposes Settlement or Records Decision
use_cases.goal: Mediator proposes a settlement or records a decision for the dispute.
use_cases.trigger: Mediator has reviewed the dispute and is ready to act.

success_postconditions.text: Settlement proposal or decision is recorded and parties are notified.

failure_postconditions.text: Proposal or decision is not recorded; mediator is informed.

steps.action: Mediator proposes a settlement.
System notifies both parties of the proposed settlement.
Mediator records a decision.
System notifies both parties of the decision.

user_stories.capability: propose a settlement or record a decision

system_stories.system_action: Record settlement proposal or decision and notify parties.
system_stories.responsibility: Capture mediator's resolution and inform stakeholders.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Mediator Proposes Settlement or Records Decision
Goal: Mediator proposes a settlement or records a decision for the dispute.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: Mediator has reviewed the dispute and is ready to act.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: Mediator has reviewed the dispute.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Mediator proposes a settlement.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] System notifies both parties of the proposed settlement.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC004-ALT-001: Mediator records decision
Source FRs: FR-006

use_cases.name: Accept Proposed Settlement
use_cases.goal: Either party accepts a proposed settlement.
use_cases.trigger: A settlement has been proposed and is pending acceptance.

preconditions.text: A settlement has been proposed and is pending acceptance.

success_postconditions.text: Settlement is accepted by both parties and dispute is closed.

failure_postconditions.text: Settlement is not accepted; dispute remains open.

steps.action: Buyer accepts the proposed settlement.
System checks if both parties have accepted.
System closes the dispute.
Seller accepts the proposed settlement.
System checks if both parties have accepted.
System closes the dispute.

user_stories.benefit: I can resolve the dispute without further mediation
I can resolve the dispute without further mediation

system_stories.system_action: Record acceptance and close dispute when both parties accept.
system_stories.responsibility: Track mutual acceptance and close dispute upon settlement.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-005 — Accept Proposed Settlement
Goal: Either party accepts a proposed settlement.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: A settlement has been proposed and is pending acceptance.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC005-001: A settlement has been proposed and is pending acceptance.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC005-001] Buyer accepts the proposed settlement.
  2. [STEP-UC005-002] System checks if both parties have accepted.
  3. [STEP-UC005-003] System closes the dispute.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC005-ALT-001: Seller accepts settlement
Source FRs: FR-007, FR-008

use_cases.name: Close Dispute
use_cases.goal: System closes the dispute after a decision or mutual settlement.
use_cases.trigger: A decision has been recorded or both parties have accepted a settlement.

success_postconditions.text: Dispute is closed and parties are notified.

steps.action: System detects a decision has been recorded.

steps.action: System closes the dispute and notifies both parties.
steps.expected_result: Dispute is closed and parties are notified.

alternative_scenarios.name: System closes dispute after mutual settlement

steps.expected_result: System proceeds to close the dispute.

steps.action: System closes the dispute and notifies both parties.
steps.expected_result: Dispute is closed and parties are notified.

system_stories.system_action: Close dispute upon decision or mutual settlement and notify parties.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure dispute is closed only when closure conditions are met.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-006 — Close Dispute
Goal: System closes the dispute after a decision or mutual settlement.
Primary actor: ACT-004
Trigger: A decision has been recorded or both parties have accepted a settlement.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC006-001: A decision has been recorded or both parties have accepted a settlement.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC006-001] System detects a decision has been recorded.
  2. [STEP-UC006-002] System closes the dispute and notifies both parties.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC006-ALT-001: System closes dispute after mutual settlement
Source FRs: FR-008

This is a reasonable interpretation of FR-007 combined with FR-008, but the goal wording could be clarified to reflect mutual acceptance.

UC-006 (Close Dispute) uses ACT-004 (System) as the primary actor. While FR-008 assigns closure to the system, treating the system as a primary actor is a modeling preference; a human actor or a system-triggered use case could also be used. This is non-blocking.
